summary: Flathead NF cabin site described as an L-4 cab from the 1930s; abandoned and listed gone; no source describes what remains today.

facts.status_note: Described as abandoned and gone; no source describes what remains at the site today

evidence.supports: location: six miles northwest of Big Salmon Lake, Flathead County, Montana

evidence.supports: over 8,000 fire lookouts in 49 states at one time; national inventory completed by the Forest Fire Lookout Association with the U.S. Forest Service

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Two lookout pages say the same thing (1930s L-4 cab, abandoned, gone); the firelookout.com page gives only the decade of construction, so no built event was written (events need a year). No staffing, fire, or access source was found. The FFLA list and the firelookout.com page agree on gone. Trails of the Past (Flathead NF history PDF) and the Flathead County Forest Lookouts page were searched for this site and have no history for it. The photo on firelookout.com is credited to the Dave Masters collection, but no image URL was found, so no photos are listed. Elevation is recorded in feet from the source; the record's elevation_m is still null. Read budget went over the per-tower guide (about 7 page reads) because the sources are thin. WebSearch used twice.
